description: Pipedrive CRM with RESTful API using API tokens or OAuth 2.0, webhooks and SDKs.
auth_notes: Per-account API token for manual integrations; OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, refresh tokens) for apps.
gate_detail: Every plan includes an API token at no extra charge, but no free plan is stated, only a 14-day trial. Developer sandbox account can be requested. Marketplace public apps involve a listing process not detailed.
api_scope: RESTful JSON API v1/v2 covering deals, persons, organizations, leads, activities, webhooks and more; official client libraries and OpenAPI 3 specs.
mcp_notes: No MCP server mentioned in the provided sources.
blocker_detail: A Pipedrive account is needed; sources show a 14-day trial and no free plan, so ongoing API use implies a paid plan.

evidence.quote: Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free.
Secure authentication is managed using OAuth 2.0 authentication.
The API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.
To test your applications, we recommend creating a new, separate Pipedrive account for sandboxing purposes.
Many companies, including Pipedrive, offer new users a 14-day free CRM trial to see if the software suits their needs.

uncertainties: Whether any permanent free plan exists is not stated
Marketplace public app approval requirements not detailed
MCP absence only inferred from sources not mentioning it
